translation: <ins>Feng Kou Yao (封口藥)</ins> Treats injuries from falls and blows, torn skin and broken flesh, and wounds from metal blades cutting the throat, severing the ear, missing lips, breaking the belly skin, and breaking the scrotal skin, and similar conditions, with great effect. Bright pure frankincense (明淨乳香), myrrh (沒藥), catechu (兒茶), Chinese angelica (當歸), cedar bark charcoal (杉皮炭, each one qian), musk (麝香, five li), borneol (片腦, one fen), pig's ear leaf (豬𧰷聹葉; if this leaf is not available, kudzu leaf or mao teng zi leaf may be used, one qian). Grind each of the above separately into fine powder, weigh and mix evenly, add musk and grind fine, then add borneol and grind evenly, store in a porcelain jar for use. <ins>Xiao Du Ding Tong San (消毒定痛散)</ins> Treats injuries from falls and blows, with hard swelling and pain.
